nodes.name: Catch prep error
nodes.notes: Native Error Trigger for automatic production failures. Choose this workflow in main Settings → Error workflow. It does not need n8n public API access and does not receive original failed input.

nodes.name: Prepare safe error
nodes.notes: Create exactly the existing postcall_errors columns from safe metadata only. Never copy error stack, original message, input, transcript, briefing or response_url. Original errors may contain customer/provider content, so store type/status and a safe explanation instead. No API credential.

nodes.name: Log prep error
nodes.notes: Insert sanitized metadata into EXISTING postcall_errors. Credential: Meeting Prep Supabase. Input: exact row from Prepare safe error; output: inserted row or error. Logging failure still attempts admin Slack.

nodes.name: Alert prep admin

parameters.text:
={{ 'Meeting prep failed.
Node: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.failed_node+'
Reason: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.error_message+'
Error row saved: '+Boolean($('Log prep error').first().json.id) }}

nodes.notes: Post only safe metadata to an internal admin channel. Credential: Meeting Prep Slack. Replace <YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID> and invite the bot. Native Slack node rejects API errors. No retry or recursive error handler.
